name: Exhaustion after frenzy (Madness — Tribute of Morgu)

system.description: When the frenzy ends, the target collapses and remains exhausted for half its effective duration. If it is not cooled down, it takes 1, 2, or 4 damage per round for two rounds after Rage, Madness, or Riastarthae, with no armor protection.
